title: Dimension — a linear dimension on a segment, with its measured length
description:
A LINEAR DIMENSION attached to a wall segment, on the six-node spine:

  Geometry → Input Properties → Math Engine → Output Metrics → 2D Render + 3D Render

Attach it to a segment and it measures that segment: two extension lines standing off the host, a dimension line at `offset`, and an end mark at each end. `flip` puts it on the other side, so a run of dimensions along a boundary sits consistently outside it.

LINE TYPE is geometry, not style. A Stroke row draws one band per segment, so Dashed and Dotted are built as N segments along the line rather than as a dash pattern — which is why they scale with the drawing instead of with the zoom.

NO TEXT. 2D Render has three kinds — polygon, circle, stroke — and none of them letters a string, so this object cannot draw its own value on the canvas. The measured length is published as a metric instead: it reads out in the Properties panel, travels on a wire, and is what `show_value_only` leaves behind when it suppresses every drawn piece.

3D is empty on purpose. A dimension is an annotation; it has no solid.

params.name: Dimension maths
params.expr:
# ── Host ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# P arrives as the host segment's endpoints [[x1, y1], [x2, y2]] in metres, local to the anchor.
# Only the FIRST TWO rows are read, so a host that arrives with more (a Space) dimensions its first
# edge instead of failing outright. Every published figure and every drawn row is gated on _ok, so an
# unhosted instance measures 0 and draws nothing rather than putting a phantom line at the origin.
_n = rows(P)
_hasP = _n >= 2 ? 1 : 0
_Q = _hasP > 0 ? sub(P, 0, 0, 2, 2) : vcat(hcat(0, 0), hcat(0, 0))
_a = row(_Q, 0)
_b = row(_Q, 1)
_v = _b - _a
_L = min(len(_v))
_ok = _hasP > 0 && _L > 1e-9 ? 1 : 0

# Unit vector along the segment, and the perpendicular the dimension is offset along. `perp` of
# (ux, uy) is (-uy, ux); `flip` mirrors it to the other side of the segment, which is what makes a
# run of dimensions sit consistently outside a boundary rather than alternating.
_u = _ok > 0 ? normalize(_v) : hcat(1, 0)
_ux = min(col(_u, 0))
_uy = min(col(_u, 1))
_side = flip > 0 ? -1 : 1
_nx = 0 - _uy * _side
_ny = _ux * _side

_ax = min(col(_a, 0))
_ay = min(col(_a, 1))
_bx = min(col(_b, 0))
_by = min(col(_b, 1))

# ── Dimension line ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# The measured line, parallel to the host at `offset`. A NEGATIVE offset is legal and puts it on the
# other side; `_m` carries that sign so the extension lines below still run outward from the host
# rather than back through it.
_off = offset
_m = _off >= 0 ? 1 : -1
_A1x = _ax + _nx * _off
_A1y = _ay + _ny * _off
_B1x = _bx + _nx * _off
_B1y = _by + _ny * _off

# ── Extension lines ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# From just clear of the host point (`extGap` — the gap is what keeps the witness line from touching
# the wall it measures) to just past the dimension line (`extOver`).
# NOTE: every call stays on ONE LINE. The body is split on newlines before it is parsed, so a call
# broken across lines is not a continuation — the opening line fails to parse and the rest is dropped
# as "not an assignment", which shows up as a silent 0 rather than an error.
_g0 = _m * extGap
_g1 = _off + _m * extOver
_ExtA = hcat(_ax + _nx * _g0, _ay + _ny * _g0, _ax + _nx * _g1, _ay + _ny * _g1)
_ExtB = hcat(_bx + _nx * _g0, _by + _ny * _g0, _bx + _nx * _g1, _by + _ny * _g1)
_Ext = vcat(_ExtA, _ExtB)

# ── Line type: solid / dashed / dotted ───────────────────────────────────────
# A Stroke row draws one band per segment, so a dashed line is not a style — it is N segments. Built
# by BROADCAST rather than a loop: `arange` gives the dash index, and every dash's start and end come
# out as a column. A dash that would start past the end of the line collapses to zero length, and the
# renderer drops zero-length segments, so the count needs no exact fit.
_solid = lineType == 'Solid'
_dotted = lineType == 'Dotted'
_dash = _dotted ? 0.02 : dashLength
_gap = _dotted ? dashGap * 0.6 : dashGap
_per = max(0.005, _dash + _gap)
_nd = _solid ? 1 : min(400, max(1, floor(_L / _per) + 1))
_t0 = _solid ? zeros(1, 1) : arange(_nd) * _per
_t1 = _solid ? fill(1, 1, _L) : min(_t0 + _dash, _L)
_Dim = hcat(_A1x + _ux * _t0, _A1y + _uy * _t0, _A1x + _ux * _t1, _A1y + _uy * _t1)

# ── End marks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# `_h` is the half-length of a 45 degree tick; `_ah` / `_aw` are the length and half-width of an
# arrowhead. Both heads point INWARD along the dimension line, which is why the barbs at B run along
# -u while the ones at A run along +u.
_h = markSize / 2
_tx = (_ux + _nx) / sqrt(2)
_ty = (_uy + _ny) / sqrt(2)
_TickA = hcat(_A1x - _tx * _h, _A1y - _ty * _h, _A1x + _tx * _h, _A1y + _ty * _h)
_TickB = hcat(_B1x - _tx * _h, _B1y - _ty * _h, _B1x + _tx * _h, _B1y + _ty * _h)
_Tick = vcat(_TickA, _TickB)
_ah = markSize
_aw = markSize * 0.35
_A2x = _A1x + _ux * _ah
_A2y = _A1y + _uy * _ah
_B2x = _B1x - _ux * _ah
_B2y = _B1y - _uy * _ah
_OpA1 = hcat(_A1x, _A1y, _A2x + _nx * _aw, _A2y + _ny * _aw)
_OpA2 = hcat(_A1x, _A1y, _A2x - _nx * _aw, _A2y - _ny * _aw)
_OpB1 = hcat(_B1x, _B1y, _B2x + _nx * _aw, _B2y + _ny * _aw)
_OpB2 = hcat(_B1x, _B1y, _B2x - _nx * _aw, _B2y - _ny * _aw)
_Open = vcat(_OpA1, _OpA2, _OpB1, _OpB2)
# Filled heads are POLYGONS, not strokes: a third column groups the rows, so both triangles travel as
# one list and the row draws them as two separate pieces.
_HdA0 = hcat(_A1x, _A1y, 0)
_HdA1 = hcat(_A2x + _nx * _aw, _A2y + _ny * _aw, 0)
_HdA2 = hcat(_A2x - _nx * _aw, _A2y - _ny * _aw, 0)
_HdB0 = hcat(_B1x, _B1y, 1)
_HdB1 = hcat(_B2x + _nx * _aw, _B2y + _ny * _aw, 1)
_HdB2 = hcat(_B2x - _nx * _aw, _B2y - _ny * _aw, 1)
_Head = vcat(_HdA0, _HdA1, _HdA2, _HdB0, _HdB1, _HdB2)

# ── The value ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# The figure is NOT drawn here. An Output slot marked `showInCanvas` is rendered by the canvas as real
# TEXT at the host's anchor — a segment's midpoint — so the measurement reads as type rather than as
# geometry, and it stays upright and legible at any zoom. `valueUnit` picks what that number means:
# metres to two decimals, or whole millimetres.
_mm = valueUnit == 'mm'
value = _mm ? round(_L * 1000) : round(_L * 100) / 100

# ── What actually gets drawn ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# `show_value_only` drops the extension lines, the dimension line and the end marks. The measured
# value is unaffected: it is canvas TEXT driven by the Output slot below, not geometry, so what is
# left is a bare figure floating where the dimension would have been.
_draw = _ok > 0 && show_value_only < 1 ? 1 : 0
_arrow = endType == 'Arrow'
_tick = endType == 'Tick'
_open = endType == 'Open'
_Marks = _tick ? _Tick : (_open ? _Open : zeros(0, 4))
_Rule = _draw > 0 ? vcat(_Ext, _Dim, _Marks) : zeros(0, 4)
# HAIRLINE. A Stroke row does not draw a line — it draws a BAND of the row's width, which the canvas
# then outlines. At any useful zoom a band wide enough to see is wide enough to read as TWO parallel
# lines with a wash between them, which is what a dimension must never look like. A fifth column gives
# each segment its own width, so the band collapses to `lineWeight` (1 mm by default, the engine's
# floor) and the two long edges land on the same pixel: one hairline, at whatever zoom.
_lw = max(0.001, lineWeight)
_nL = rows(_Rule)
_Lines = _nL > 0 ? hcat(_Rule, fill(_nL, 1, _lw)) : zeros(0, 5)
_Heads = _draw > 0 && _arrow ? _Head : zeros(0, 3)

# ── Colour -> which row gets the geometry ────────────────────────────────────
# A 2D Render row's colour is a property OF THE ROW: a Math Engine can only put numbers on a wire, so
# one row cannot change hue on a condition. Five rows can, and the switch becomes a question of WHICH
# ROW GETS THE GEOMETRY. Every other row receives an empty list and is skipped outright, so exactly
# one colour is ever on screen and two can never stack.
LinesBlack = color == 'Black' ? _Lines : zeros(0, 4)
LinesRed = color == 'Red' ? _Lines : zeros(0, 4)
LinesBlue = color == 'Blue' ? _Lines : zeros(0, 4)
LinesGreen = color == 'Green' ? _Lines : zeros(0, 4)
LinesOrange = color == 'Orange' ? _Lines : zeros(0, 4)
HeadsBlack = color == 'Black' ? _Heads : zeros(0, 3)
HeadsRed = color == 'Red' ? _Heads : zeros(0, 3)
HeadsBlue = color == 'Blue' ? _Heads : zeros(0, 3)
HeadsGreen = color == 'Green' ? _Heads : zeros(0, 3)
HeadsOrange = color == 'Orange' ? _Heads : zeros(0, 3)

# ── Metrics ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
length = _ok * _L
lengthMm = _ok * _L * 1000
bearing = _ok * min(angle(_v))
offsetUsed = _ok * _off
midX = _ok * (_ax + _bx) / 2
midY = _ok * (_ay + _by) / 2
